messages:
omar: Heads-up — ACME sent a late replay last night that overlapped the nightly batch. We're seeing negative deltas in the ledger and some customers got temporary double credits. Can @claire or @katie pick this up?

katie: Ugh. Do we have the raw payloads? Sounds like their replay didn't set the `replay_id` or used non-idempotent event ids.

acme-ing-engineer: sorry about this — we had a backfill script that retried on 429s and ended up re-posting ~3k events with new uuids. attaching sample: ```json
{"customer_id":"cust-42","usage":1200,"timestamp":"2026-03-12T00:00:00Z","event_id":"evt-XXXX"}
```

claire: Thanks. From the ledger side the symptom is: same entitlement fingerprint but different event ids -> our dedupe didn't catch it. We flagged negative credits for ~14 accounts.

sam: Support is getting pings from two customers. They've paused product features until this is resolved. We need a short customer-facing statement and ETA.

omar: Proposed plan: (1) create an exception ticket and hand off to Billing Ops to reconcile and apply manual adjustments, (2) add a short-runbook for partner replays, (3) patch our ingest dedupe to also check `replay_id` header if present and for now block replays without it. Thoughts? @billing-ops-bot create-ticket please.

billing-ops-bot: New exception ticket created: EX-2026-342. Assigned to @claire. Summary: "ACME replay overlap -> negative credits". SLA: 48h.

claire: I'll own the ticket. First step: run a query to identify unique customer fingerprints and aggregate the net delta. If net < 0 for an account, we re-run the hourly reconciliation with the pre-replay snapshot and queue a manual credit reversal. Need list of affected cust_ids from @acme-ing-engineer.

acme-ing-engineer: sending a CSV to your email now with event ids and timestamps. Also we'll disable the backfill immediately and add `replay_id` header to future replays. Apologies.

katie: On the infra side I'll scope a quick ingest guard: if we detect a replay window and the partner hasn't supplied `replay_id`, reject and return 422 with a clear error. That buys us time while Claire does manual fixes.

sam: For customers: drafting message — short apology, impact (credit mismatch visible in billing portal), actions we're taking, and ETA for fixes + crediting. Will share draft in #support-drafts in 30m.

claire: Once I have the affected list I'll run a dry-run reconcile and post the SQL + diffs here for review before applying. Expect initial results in ~3 hours.

omar: Thanks all. Action items: @acme-ing-engineer send CSV (done), @katie implement ingest guard (P0 for next few hours), @claire run dry-run and create reimbursements, @sam publish customer note. I'll follow up with ACME PM to confirm process change. :thumbsup:

katie: small note — we should also add a metric/alert: replay-rate > 0.1% triggers partner-integration alert so we catch noisy backfills earlier. Adding to my queue.

claire: dry-run complete. Posting diff summary: 14 accounts with negative net, total over-credited tokens: 18,400. Will queue manual reversals and attach audit IDs to ticket EX-2026-342.

sam: Customer note posted and pinned. Two customers confirmed acknowledgement.

omar: Closing loop — ACME added `replay_id` and updated their client. Thanks team. We'll keep EX-2026-342 open for 48h for verification and then close.
